base_requirement_text: When a customer submits an order, the system shall send a confirmation email to the customer within 30 seconds.

controlled_context.domain: Online retail platform for consumer electronics.

glossary.definition: Automated transactional message sent to the customer after a successful order placement.

business_rules.rule: Sending the confirmation email is a mandatory functional action triggered by order submission and is independent of the delivery time window.

constraints.text: Confirmation emails must be delivered within 30 seconds of order submission. This is a quality of service constraint, not part of the functional sending action.
